searchText: Teku nodes look far behind in Attacknet with a lot of memory consumed. Are you going to restart them? Update with Teku was troublesome, 3 packed behind at first, but got them synced. Looks like they have problems again Will investigate Teku nodes don't run the full 1/3 of keys now, so net should stay relatively stable. It was hitting memory limits due to JVM being too eager. Tuning JVM memory limit, removing keystore lockfiles (prevented the automated restarts, eth2stats client entries are live but not updating due to restart fails), and restarting. Hope to have Teku back soon 🙂 It may be stopping because of another reason, memory limit changes didn't help. Investigating... Teku is back in the game. Fun configuration issue on our end: allocated a lot to the JVM heap, but (afaik) should have left more buffer for non-java buffers (network, rocksdb, etc.).
